---
title: "03 - Clustering"
subtitle: "Leiden over the resolution ladder, and how well each resolution holds"
---

```{r}
source("_helpers.R")
source("_figures.R")
cs_f <- find_tab("^cluster_summary\\.csv$")
cs <- read_files(cs_f, colClasses = c(resolution = "character"))
rc_f <- find_tab("^resolution_checks\\.csv$")
rc <- read_files(rc_f, colClasses = c(resolution = "character"))
st_f <- find_tab("^stability_clusters\\.csv$")
pick <- if (!is.null(rc) && "picked" %in% names(rc)) rc[picked %in% TRUE, resolution] else character()
res <- if (!is.null(cs)) cs$resolution else if (!is.null(rc)) rc$resolution else character()
res <- res[order(as.numeric(res))]
res_label <- function(r) {
  paste0("Leiden ", r, if (r %in% RUN$chosen) " (chosen)", if (r %in% pick) " (picked)")
}
## Dashed lines at the chosen resolutions and a solid one at the pick ##
res_lines <- function() {
  list(
    if (length(RUN$chosen)) geom_vline(xintercept = as.numeric(RUN$chosen), linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey60"),
    if (length(pick)) geom_vline(xintercept = as.numeric(pick), colour = "grey25")
  )
}
```

A shared-nearest-neighbour graph on the batch-corrected embedding is clustered with Leiden at every resolution of the ladder. The checks score each resolution, and the stability check picks the one whose clusters hold best when 80% of the cells are clustered again.

```{r}
page_top(
  stages = c("discover", "checks"),
  Input = "The batch-corrected embedding and its dimensions, <code>dims_use</code>.",
  Method = "An sNN graph with <code>knn_k</code> neighbours, Leiden at each resolution in <code>leiden_res_ladder</code>, and UMAPs and marker diagnostics for <code>chosen_resolutions</code>.",
  Checks = "The cluster tree and the silhouette at every resolution. With <code>checks_stability</code>, three re-clusterings of 80% of the cells score each cluster by its best Jaccard overlap, and the resolution with the highest median Jaccard is picked, the coarser one on a tie.",
  Output = "One <code>leiden_clus_res</code> column per resolution on the object, and the tables in <code>tables/03_clustering</code>."
)
```

```{r}
#| output: asis
cat(render_tree(list(
  "Resolutions" = function() {
    if (is.null(cs)) return(missing_note("Not clustered yet."))
    d <- copy(cs)[, .(resolution, n_clusters)]
    mix <- lapply(d$resolution, function(r) read_tab(paste0("^sample_mix_res", rx(r), "\\.csv$")))
    d[, max_sample_share := vapply(mix, function(m) if (is.null(m)) NA_real_ else max(as.matrix(m[, -1]), na.rm = TRUE), 0)]
    d[, mostly_one_sample := vapply(mix, function(m) if (is.null(m)) NA_integer_ else sum(apply(as.matrix(m[, -1]), 1, max) > 0.8), 0L)]
    extra <- intersect(c("silhouette", "median_sc3_stability", "median_jaccard", "stable_clusters", "cells_in_stable_pct"), names(rc))
    if (length(extra)) d <- merge(d, rc[, c("resolution", extra), with = FALSE], by = "resolution", all.x = TRUE)
    d[, chosen := ifelse(resolution %in% RUN$chosen, "yes", "")]
    if (length(pick)) d[, picked := ifelse(resolution %in% pick, "yes", "")]
    d <- d[order(as.numeric(resolution))]
    checks <- if (length(extra)) {
      rfig("resolution_checks", c(rc_f, cs_f), function() {
        m <- intersect(c("silhouette", "median_sc3_stability", "median_jaccard", "cells_in_stable_pct"), names(d))
        lab <- c(silhouette = "Silhouette", median_sc3_stability = "Median SC3 stability",
                 median_jaccard = "Median best Jaccard", cells_in_stable_pct = "Cells in stable clusters (%)")
        long <- melt(d[, c("resolution", m), with = FALSE], id.vars = "resolution", variable.name = "measure")
        long[, `:=`(resolution = as.numeric(resolution), measure = factor(lab[as.character(measure)], lab[m]))]
        ggplot(long, aes(resolution, value)) +
          res_lines() +
          geom_line(colour = TEAL, linewidth = 0.6) +
          geom_point(colour = TEAL, size = 2) +
          facet_wrap(~measure, scales = "free_y", ncol = 2) +
          labs(x = "Leiden resolution", y = NULL) +
          theme_report()
      }, 9, 5.5)
    }
    sizes <- rfig("resolution_clusters", c(cs_f, rc_f), function() {
      e <- copy(d)[, resolution := as.numeric(resolution)]
      g <- ggplot(e, aes(resolution, n_clusters)) +
        res_lines() +
        geom_col(fill = KEPT, width = 0.07) +
        labs(x = "Leiden resolution", y = "Clusters") +
        theme_report()
      if (!is.null(rc) && "clusters_under_100_cells" %in% names(rc)) {
        small <- merge(e[, .(resolution)], rc[, .(resolution = as.numeric(resolution), clusters_under_100_cells)], by = "resolution")
        g <- g + geom_col(data = small, aes(resolution, clusters_under_100_cells), fill = WARM, width = 0.07)
      }
      g
    }, 7, 3.6)
    tagList(
      if (length(pick)) {
        tags$p(HTML(paste0(
          "<b>Picked:</b> ", htmlEscape(pick), ", the highest median Jaccard. <code>cosmx-nf &lt;run_id&gt; labels</code> ",
          "and the <code>subcluster</code> stage take it when no clustering is named."
        )))
      },
      rgallery(list(
        `Each check by resolution, the chosen resolutions dashed and the pick solid` = checks,
        `Clusters per resolution, those under 100 cells in red` = sizes
      ), wide = TRUE),
      plain_table(d),
      tags$p(class = "table-note", "Max sample share: the largest share of one cluster from a single sample. Mostly one sample: clusters with more than 80% of their cells from one sample, which a small fragment can reach on its own. Silhouette: separation in the clustering embedding, higher is better. SC3 stability: how well clusters hold together across resolutions. Jaccard and stable cells: agreement with re-clustering 80% of the cells, stable at 0.75 or more."),
      csv_links(c(cs_f, rc_f))
    )
  },
  "Cluster stability" = function() {
    st <- read_files(st_f, colClasses = c(resolution = "character", cluster = "character"))
    if (is.null(st)) return(missing_note("Not checked in this run. checks_stability runs it."))
    fig <- rfig("cluster_stability", st_f, function() {
      e <- copy(st)[, `:=`(stable = mean_jaccard >= 0.75, resolution = factor(paste("Leiden", resolution), paste("Leiden", res)))]
      ggplot(e, aes(n_cells, mean_jaccard, colour = stable)) +
        geom_hline(yintercept = 0.75, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey60") +
        geom_point(size = 1.8, alpha = 0.9) +
        scale_x_log10(labels = scales::label_comma()) +
        scale_colour_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = TEAL, `FALSE` = WARM), labels = c(`TRUE` = "stable", `FALSE` = "unstable"), name = NULL) +
        facet_wrap(~resolution, ncol = 5) +
        labs(x = "Cells in the cluster", y = "Mean best Jaccard") +
        theme_report()
    }, 11, 1.6 + 2.2 * ceiling(length(res) / 5))
    tagList(
      rgallery(list(`Each cluster's stability against its size, stable at 0.75 or more` = fig), big = TRUE),
      hits_table(st, csv = st_f, note = "Each cluster's mean best Jaccard over three re-clusterings of 80% of the cells.")
    )
  },
  "UMAP per resolution" = function() {
    cols <- paste0("leiden_clus_res", res)
    if (length(res) && bundle_has(c("UMAP1", "UMAP2"))) {
      have <- res[vapply(cols, bundle_has, logical(1))]
      if (length(have)) {
        first <- c(intersect(c(pick, RUN$chosen), have), setdiff(have, c(pick, RUN$chosen)))
        items <- lapply(first, function(r) umap_fig(paste0("umap_leiden_", r), paste0("leiden_clus_res", r), centroids = TRUE))
        return(rpicker(stats::setNames(items, vapply(first, res_label, ""))))
      }
    }
    f <- vapply(res, function(r) {
      a <- res_path("figures", "03_clustering", paste0("umap_leiden_res", r, ".png"))
      b <- res_path("figures", "03_clustering", paste0("umap_leiden_clus_res", r, ".png"))
      if (file.exists(a)) a else if (file.exists(b)) b else ""
    }, "")
    keep <- nzchar(f)
    figure_picker(unname(f[keep]), vapply(res[keep], res_label, ""), empty = "No UMAPs yet.")
  },
  "Samples in each cluster" = function() {
    rs <- unique(c(pick, RUN$chosen))
    rs <- rs[vapply(rs, function(r) length(find_tab(paste0("^sample_mix_res", rx(r), "\\.csv$"))) > 0, logical(1))]
    if (!length(rs)) return(missing_note("No sample mix tables yet."))
    figs_mix <- lapply(rs, function(r) {
      f <- find_tab(paste0("^sample_mix_res", rx(r), "\\.csv$"))
      rfig(paste0("sample_mix_", r), f, function() {
        d <- read_files(f, colClasses = list(character = 1))
        setnames(d, 1, "cluster")
        long <- melt(d, id.vars = "cluster", variable.name = "sample", value.name = "share")
        long[, `:=`(cluster = factor(cluster, rev(cluster_levels(cluster))), sample = factor(sample, sample_levels(as.character(sample))))]
        ggplot(long, aes(share, cluster, fill = sample)) +
          geom_col(width = 0.8) +
          geom_vline(xintercept = 0.8, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50") +
          scale_fill_manual(values = sample_colours(levels(long$sample)), name = NULL) +
          scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent(), expand = expansion(c(0, 0.01))) +
          labs(x = "Share of the cluster's cells", y = "Cluster") +
          theme_report()
      }, 8, 1.4 + 0.24 * nrow(fread(f[1], header = TRUE, select = 1L)))
    })
    tagList(
      rpicker(stats::setNames(figs_mix, vapply(rs, res_label, ""))),
      tabs(setNames(lapply(rs, function(r) {
        f <- find_tab(paste0("^sample_mix_res", rx(r), "\\.csv$"))
        d <- read_files(f, colClasses = list(character = 1))
        setnames(d, 1, "cluster")
        hits_table(d, csv = f, note = "Each cluster's share of cells from each sample.")
      }), vapply(rs, res_label, "")))
    )
  },
  "Cluster tree" = function() {
    tagList(
      gallery_named("03_clustering/checks", c("clustree.png" = "How the clusters split as the resolution rises"), big = TRUE, empty = "No cluster tree yet."),
      csv_links(find_tab("^clustree_nodes\\.csv$"))
    )
  },
  "Marker diagnostics" = function() {
    have <- sub("_de_top\\.csv$", "", basename(find_tab("^leiden_clus_res.+_de_top\\.csv$")))
    first <- paste0("leiden_clus_res", unique(c(pick, RUN$chosen)))
    cols <- unique(c(intersect(first, have), have[order(as.numeric(sub("^leiden_clus_res", "", have)))]))
    marker_tabs(cols, vapply(sub("^leiden_clus_res", "", cols), res_label, ""))
  },
  ".pipeline" = function() pipeline_figures(c(figs("03_clustering", "^umap_leiden.+\\.png$", FALSE), figs("03_clustering/checks"))),
  "Parameters" = function() {
    tagList(
      params_table(c("knn_k", "n_iterations", "leiden_res_ladder", "chosen_resolutions", "top_n",
                     "marker_min_detection", "marker_min_panel_genes", "marker_min_score"), "discover"),
      params_table(c("checks", "checks_stability"), latest_stage(c("discover", "checks")))
    )
  }
)))
```
